source_caption:
🎬 I Feel Pretty (2018)

I Feel Pretty follows Renee Bennett, an ordinary woman living in New York City who struggles with insecurity and constantly compares herself to society’s unrealistic beauty standards. Despite having a good job, supportive friends, and a fun personality, Renee believes that her appearance prevents her from achieving the happiness and confidence she desires. Everything changes when she suffers a head injury during a cycling class and suddenly begins seeing herself as extraordinarily beautiful, even though her physical appearance hasn’t changed at all. With newfound confidence, Renee starts taking risks she previously avoided, pursuing exciting career opportunities, developing romantic relationships, and embracing life with an entirely different attitude. However, as her confidence grows, she begins to overlook the feelings of those closest to her and must eventually confront what truly makes someone beautiful. Through hilarious misunderstandings, awkward situations, and heartfelt moments, Renee discovers that self-worth comes from within. Combining entertaining comedy, relatable struggles, and uplifting storytelling, the film explores confidence, body image, friendship, self-acceptance, and the importance of believing in yourself.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Romance

⭐ IMDb: 5.7/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 50m • PG-13

🎥 Directors: Abby Kohn and Marc Silverstein

🏆 Recognition: Starring Amy Schumer, Michelle Williams, Emily Ratajkowski, Busy Philipps, and Aidy Bryant, the film became a commercial success, earning approximately $94 million worldwide. Known for its humorous exploration of beauty standards, memorable comedic performances, and message about self-confidence, it sparked conversations about body image and the influence of self-perception on everyday life.

source_details.synopsis: I Feel Pretty is a 2018 American comedy film written and directed by Abby Kohn and Marc Silverstein (in their directorial debuts). The film stars Amy Schumer, Michelle Williams, Emily Ratajkowski, Rory Scovel, Aidy Bryant, Busy Philipps, Tom Hopper, Naomi Campbell, and Lauren Hutton. The plot involves an insecure woman who, after suffering a head injury, gains extreme self-confidence in her appearance. The film was released in the United States on April 20, 2018, by STX Entertainment, and grossed $94.5 million worldwide. It received mixed reviews from critics, with some saying it did not fully commit to its premise or tone, although the performances of both Schumer and Williams were praised.
